test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Find the correct option to fix the misspelled word in the sentence."

The disadvantages of listening to music at a loud voluume include loss of hearing.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4. i.e. **Volume.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **voluume** in the given sentence is **incorrectly **spelt. The correct spelling is **Volume**.
